message: Relation field "Post.nullable": onDelete: SetNull sets the foreign key fields to null, but "Post.a" is required, so Prisma 8 cannot describe this foreign key. Make "Post.a" optional, which drops NOT NULL on Prisma 7's next migration and makes it nullable in the Prisma 7 client, or choose another action, which replaces the foreign key on Prisma 7's next migration and leaves the Prisma 7 client unchanged.

Relation field "Post.generated": onDelete: SetDefault sets the foreign key fields to their column defaults, but "Post.b" is required and has no column default (a client-side generator such as uuid() does not give the column one), so Prisma 8 cannot describe this foreign key. Replace the @default on "Post.b" with a column default, such as a literal or @default(dbgenerated("<expression>")), because a field takes only one @default: Prisma 7's next migration sets it and the Prisma 7 client stops generating a value for "Post.b". Or choose another action, which replaces the foreign key on Prisma 7's next migration and leaves the Prisma 7 client unchanged.

Relation field "Member.team": onDelete: SetDefault sets the foreign key fields to their column defaults, but "Member.teamId" and "Member.region" are required and have no column default (a client-side generator such as uuid() does not give the column one), so Prisma 8 cannot describe this foreign key. Give "Member.region" a column default, such as a literal or @default(dbgenerated("<expression>")), and replace the @default on "Member.teamId" with one, because a field takes only one @default: Prisma 7's next migration sets them, "Member.region" becomes optional when creating records with the Prisma 7 client and the Prisma 7 client stops generating a value for "Member.teamId". Or choose another action, which replaces the foreign key on Prisma 7's next migration and leaves the Prisma 7 client unchanged.
